record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, replace each supervised GRU-state readout with 0.8*h_t + 0.2*m_t, where m_t is the normalized exponentially weighted mean of real-item states through t, with a four-interaction half-life. Exclude padding from the mean and use only causal prefixes. Apply the same readout at the final real position during inference. This may retain broader interests while emphasizing recent behavior. Keep history truncation, embeddings, GRU topology, dot-product scoring, loss and optimizer fixed; update the predictor writer consistently.
